note: Art-only description per hero. Gameplay identity, names and skills come from data/vnext/catalog.json. Edit here, then run tools/vnext/build_hero_art_briefs.py. Optional per hero: 'extra' (a floating or standing object beside the hero), 'pose' (replaces the standard A-pose sentence), 'expression', and 'reference' (an existing set whose folders predate the full/body/items layout). An accessory is [name, description] or [name, description, 'creature'] for a summon.

races.human: natural human skin tones; practical medieval kingdom gear of steel, wool and leather with brass fittings
races.elf: tall and slender with long pointed ears swept back; elegant gear with leaf, bark and silver motifs
races.dwarf: short and very broad with big hands, a big nose and a heavy beard; chunky riveted iron, copper and brass gear
races.goblin: small and wiry with yellow-green skin, very large pointed ears, a long nose and sharp teeth; scavenged, patched gear and bare feet
races.orc: big and heavy with green skin, a heavy brow and two lower tusks; tribal gear of hide, fur, bone and stone
races.beastkin: upright humanoid body covered in fur or feathers with a full animal head and clawed hands; simple tribal leather and cloth
races.demon: horned, with red or purple skin and glowing eyes; black iron gear and one glowing accent colour
races.undead: bone, grey pallor and stitches; torn, faded cloth and a cold glow in the eyes
races.elemental: the body is made of the element itself, with no clothing, two simple glowing eyes and no mouth
races.dragonkin: upright dragon-headed humanoid with scales, horns, a tail and clawed digitigrade feet; regal bearing
